notes: ALL SET (不用記帳) is a Cloudflare Worker (Hono API) that also serves the built Svelte SPA from apps/web/dist. Setup: mise.toml pins node 22.22.0; `npm ci`; `npx vite build` in apps/web; .ui-capture/wrangler.capture.toml is a local-only copy of apps/worker/wrangler.local.toml.example (local D1, no remote bindings). .ui-capture/seed.sh rebuilds the DB from scratch: applies all D1 migrations (which also install default categories/rules and sync jobs), loads seed.sql produced by generate-seed.mjs, then starts the app briefly and seeds via its own API (api-seed.mjs: encrypted connector settings for 台新/玉山/國泰世華/集保/電子發票, ~240 cash-wallet manual transactions, 5 user classification rules, deposit-history rebuild), then post.sql sets sync-job status (台新/玉山/集保/電子發票 synced successfully this morning; 國泰世華 is in needs_user_action waiting for an SMS OTP, last success 11/14). start.sh only starts the stub + wrangler dev on PORT (default 4420); no network needed. Data (persona: Taipei software engineer, 2026-03-01 → 2026-11-17): 11 bank accounts (台新 Richart salary account, 玉山 daily account, 國泰世華 USD account, 元大 settlement account, CUBE/Pi/@GoGo credit cards with statements & autopay, 國泰 personal loan, TWD/USD time deposits incl. one matured), ~760 bank/card transactions (salary, rent, transfers, card spending, refunds, rewards, Japan-trip foreign charges, pending card auths in the last 2 days, notes, exclusions, category overrides), 25 credit-card bills (latest Pi bill due tomorrow, unpaid), daily balance snapshots, ~390 e-invoices with ~870 line items, TDCC holdings (8 stocks/ETFs, 3 funds) with 59 trades/dividends and daily stock/fund value history, 5 manual assets (pre-sale house payments, USD life policy, scooter, labor pension, JPY cash) with history, exchange rates. Main areas (hash routes): #/overview 總覽 (net worth, trend chart, recent activity), #/assets 資產 (institutions, accounts, cards, loans, investments, manual assets), #/activity 活動 (monthly income/expense breakdown, unified timeline, search, invoice matching), #/settings 設定 (connectors, sync schedule, classification rules, exchange rates, notifications). Re-seed from scratch with `.ui-capture/seed.sh` (uses a temporary server on SEED_PORT, default 5433). The worker also serves the API at /api/*.
